exposure: Changes in prenatal care due to COVID-19 pandemic
Changes in birth plans due to COVID-19 pandemic
outcome: Changes in access to prenatal care
Reasons for unwillingness to receive COVID-19 vaccination
finding: The COVID-19 pandemic led to significant changes in prenatal care and birth plans, with a high proportion of pregnant women experiencing disruptions in care and opting for Cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: Two-thirds of pregnant women experienced a change in birth plans, including shifting from hospital birth to home birth (18%) or from vaginal birth to Cesarean delivery (17%).
